decisions: Define the box type: folding carton, rigid gift box, mailer box, sleeve or display box.
Prepare print requirements: artwork status, color direction, finish preference and inside/outside print needs.
For UK-bound projects, clarify product category, packing use, quantity range and delivery destination before asking for a quote.
